description_zh: 创建一台或多台包年包月的轻量应用服务器实例
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open create-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-id e2c9c365024a44369c9b955a998a0000 --plan-id swas.s1.c1m1s40b3t05 --period 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateInstances

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application servers. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查询可用地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The image ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189313.html operation to query the available images in the specified region
parameters.help_zh: 镜像ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189313.html查询指定地域下可用的镜像ID
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The plan ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189314.html operation to query all plans provided by Simple Application Server in the specified region
parameters.help_zh: 套餐ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189314.html查询指定地域下的全部套餐信息
parameters.name: plan_id

parameters.help_en: The subscription period of the servers. Unit: months. Valid values: 1, 3, 6, 12, 24, and 36
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true

false

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启到期自动续费。取值范围：

true：开启
false：不开启

默认值：false
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en: The auto-renewal period. This parameter is required only when you set `AutoRenew` to true. Unit: month. Valid values: 1, 3, 6, 12, 24, and 36
parameters.help_zh: 自动续费的时长，仅当`AutoRenew=true`时该参数必填。单位：月。取值范围：{"1", "3", "6", "12", "24", "36"}
parameters.name: auto_renew_period

parameters.help_en:
The size of the data disk that is attached to the server. Unit: GB. Valid values: 0 to 16380. The value must be an integral multiple of 20.

A value of 0 indicates that no data disk is attached.

If the disk included in the specified plan is a standard SSD, the data disk must be 20 GB or larger in size.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh:
挂载的数据盘容量大小。单位：GB。取值范围：0~16380，取值必须是20的整数倍。

<props="china">
取值为0时，表示不挂载数据盘。

如果您选择的套餐使用的是ESSD云盘（性能级别PL0），则挂载的数据盘容量最小值为40 GB。

如果您选择的套餐使用的是SSD云盘，则挂载的数据盘容量最小值为20 GB。

</props>

<props="intl">
取值为0时，表示不挂载数据盘。

如果您选择的套餐使用的是SSD云盘，则挂载的数据盘容量最小值为20 GB。

</props>

默认值：0
parameters.name: data_disk_size

parameters.help_en:
The number of simple application servers that you want to create. Valid values: 1 to 20.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
创建轻量应用服务器的数量。取值范围：1~20

默认值：1
parameters.name: amount

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the simple application servers. Set the value to PrePaid, which indicates the subscription billing method.

Default value: PrePaid
parameters.help_zh:
计费方式。取值：PrePaid，目前仅支持包年包月计费方式。

默认值：PrePaid
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

InstanceIds.description_zh: 轻量应用服务器的实例ID

items.description_zh: 轻量应用服务器的实例ID
